title: [F-001] No Origin/Host validation on /api/*: CSRF and DNS-rebinding reach the loopback-trusted API
description: F-001 (src A2-001, High, conf Medium). Where: apps/rust-api/src/auth.rs:79-166 (access_control), lib.rs:1493-1509 (only /mcp gets a Host allow-list). Fix: add one middleware ahead of access_control that rejects Origin headers not in cors_origins/the app origin and, for loopback-trusted peers, validates Host against the allow-list mcp_allowed_hosts already computes. Same root cause as F-002; fix together with a regression test. Details: CODE_REVIEW_2026-10-27.md.
